Responsibilities: Al Itqan International School is seeking a qualified and experienced female teacher for its English Version (Play-Nursery section).

Position:
Play-Nursery Teacher (English Version)

Educational Qualification:
- Honours and Master’s degree in English

Experience:
- Minimum 3 years of relevant teaching experience

Gender:
- Female

Salary:
BDT 13,000 – 16,000 (Negotiable)

Class Time:
5 hours daily (8:00 AM – 1:00 PM)

Required Documents:
Interested candidates are requested to submit:
- All academic certificates
- Experience certificates
- Recent passport-size photograph

Address:
20/14 D, Tolar Bagh, Mirpur-1, Dhaka

Contact:
01714249351

Note:
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.
